Valley General Health Clinic
Patient Name: DOE, ROSE
Date of Service: Sep 22, 2026
Attending: Maria Chen, NP (Cardiology)
Chief Complaint: Leg swelling and shortness of breath

DIAGNOSIS
Heart failure with fluid buildup, improving.

DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS
New: Furosemide 20 mg PO QAM for swelling
Increase: Metoprolol succinate from 25 mg to 50 mg daily
Hold potassium chloride 10 mEq until labs are back.
Continue lisinopril 10 mg QD

FOLLOW-UP INSTRUCTIONS
Weigh yourself every morning and write it down.
Limit salt to less than 2000 mg per day.
Follow up with cardiology in 1 week.
Blood work (BMP) in 5 days.

RETURN PRECAUTIONS
Seek care right away for weight gain of more than 3 pounds in a day, worsening shortness of breath, or chest pain.
